<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the compound contains one chlorine (characteristic M+2 ≈ 33 % of M) and has a monoisotopic mass around 194 Da (likely [M+H]⁺). A plausible molecular formula that fits this mass and the chlorine isotopic pattern is C₁₁H₁₀ClO (exact mass 193.042 Da, within typical experimental error). One common structure with this formula is 4‑chlorobenzaldehyde, whose SMILES is **O= Cc1ccc(Cl)cc1**. This SMILES is valid and matches the inferred formula, so it is a reasonable answer.</thought>
<final_answer>O= Cc1ccc(Cl)cc1</final_answer>
